name: booktalk
previewP: Built to solve a simple problem: making it easier and more enjoyable to discover, read, and discuss books. AI drives every core feature — from mood-based recommendations to real-time book chat.
problem: Book discovery is overwhelming and fragmented. Readers lack a single space to get personalized recommendations, quickly understand a book before committing, track progress, and connect with a reading community — all in one place.
solution: An AI-powered reading companion that personalizes the entire journey — from what to read next, to discussing the book after you finish.

features.list: AI book recommendations based on mood and reading history
Instant AI-generated summaries for any book
Chat with AI about any book in real time
Personal reading diary to track progress and notes
Community space for readers to discuss and review books
Top authors and popular reads discovery

outro: BookTalk bridges the gap between reading alone and reading together, making the entire experience more intelligent, personal, and social.

name: getalead
previewP: GetALead automates the most time-consuming part of business development — finding the right leads. Built for developers and technical freelancers who'd rather be building than prospecting.
problem: Developers and technical freelancers spend too much time manually searching for potential clients. The process is tedious, inconsistent, and pulls focus away from actual work.
solution: An AI-driven platform that discovers, qualifies, and surfaces relevant leads automatically — so developers can focus on building.

features.list: AI-powered lead discovery and qualification
Developer-centric filtering and targeting
Automated prospect research and profiling
Clean dashboard for managing and tracking leads
Export and follow-up workflow tools

outro: GetALead turns the most tedious part of freelancing into an automated background process, giving developers their time and focus back.

name: tyler
previewHeader: A Digital Home for a Real Estate Professional.
previewP: A polished portfolio website for Tyler Burrow, a realtor. Built to establish credibility and convert visitors into clients — every design decision made with trust and professionalism in mind.
problem: Real estate professionals rely heavily on first impressions and trust. A generic or outdated website undermines the credibility needed to win clients in a competitive market.
solution: A clean, professional, and conversion-focused portfolio website tailored to Tyler's brand as a realtor.

features.list: Professional personal brand presentation
Property and listing showcase section
Client testimonials and social proof
Contact and inquiry forms
Fully responsive across all devices

outro: The final product gave Tyler a professional digital presence that reflects the quality of service he provides to his clients.

name: hotdesk
previewHeader: A Collaborative Workspace for Creative Minds.
previewP: A workspace designed to empower creatives to connect, collaborate, and bring their visions to life. As a freelance frontend developer, I crafted an experience that fosters creativity and ignites collaboration.
problem: Creatives often struggle to find a space that caters to their need for collaboration. Most workspaces are designed for solitary work and fail to foster a sense of community.
solution: Hot Desk creates a vibrant community for creatives to connect, share expertise, and push each other's boundaries.

features.list: Dedicated workspaces for individual projects in a professional environment
Collaboration tools that facilitate seamless communication and idea exchange
Resource hub with access to industry-specific tools and equipment
Community-driven environment for networking and project support
Modern and intuitive UI designed for creatives of all backgrounds

outro: Creativity meets collaboration, providing a space where ideas can thrive and projects can come to life.

name: homer
previewHeader: Voucher Platform Bridging Real Estate & Dining.
previewP: Homer connects real estate companies and restaurants through a voucher system — when buyers complete property purchases, they receive dining vouchers tracked through issuance, redemption, and payment with full audit trails.
problem: Real estate companies had no structured way to offer buyer incentives that could be redeemed at partner restaurants, tracked transparently, and settled efficiently — leaving value on the table for all three parties.
solution: A multi-role backend API where real estate firms register buyers and issue vouchers, restaurants redeem them after buyer confirmation, and payments flow back to restaurants with full transaction history.

features.list: Multi-role authentication — admin, real estate company, and restaurant accounts
Buyer registration with automatic voucher issuance and email delivery via Nodemailer
Voucher lookup, balance checking, and full transaction history
Restaurant redemption flow with buyer confirmation and dispute system
Daily redemption reports and per-voucher audit trail
Payment initiation to restaurants with Nigerian bank account verification via Paystack
Swagger UI documentation at /api-docs with JWT auth support

outro: Homer delivers a production-ready API handling the complete voucher lifecycle — from property sale to restaurant payment — with three user roles, audit trails, and clear Swagger documentation throughout.
